en.title: Jingdezhen Imperial Kiln Museum: Read Kilns, Shards and a Modern Porcelain City
en.headline: Begin With Waste, Not the Perfect Vase
en.description: Use kiln remains, roads, wells, sherd deposits and repaired vessels to understand production evidence at Jingdezhen's Imperial Kiln site.
en.heroAlt: Brick-vaulted interior of the modern Jingdezhen Imperial Kiln Museum

heroCredit.text: Interior of the modern Imperial Kiln Museum, photographed by EditQ on 25 October 2022; centre-cropped and resized. Its brick vaults interpret kiln forms but are not excavated imperial kilns.

en.featuredLinkLabel: Follow kilns, shards and repaired vessels

zh.title: 景德镇御窑博物院怎么看：窑炉、瓷片与现代瓷都
zh.headline: 先看废品，再看完整器
zh.description: 从窑炉遗迹、道路、水井、瓷片堆积和修复器物读懂景德镇御窑生产证据。
zh.heroAlt: 景德镇御窑博物院现代砖拱室内空间

heroCredit.text: 御窑博物院现代室内空间，EditQ摄于2022年10月25日；经居中裁切和缩放。砖拱借鉴窑形，但不是发掘出的御窑遗迹。

heroCredit.text: 현대 어요박물원 내부. EditQ가 2022년 10월 25일 촬영했으며 중앙부를 잘라 크기를 조정했습니다. 벽돌 아치는 가마 형태를 해석한 현대 건축이지 발굴된 어요가 아닙니다.
